findings.detail: Raw SOI equity rows contain numeric Par Amount / Shares on 31 of 36 investment rows, but the extracted C04 metric reports only 22 of 36 equity rows with shares.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate coverage flag. The C04 source artifact reports 61.1% share coverage for 36 equity rows, below the 70% threshold. Raw SOI tables 63-65 localize the equity section and show 36 equity investment rows before Total Equity Investments; 31 have numeric values in the Par Amount / Shares column. Examples include Clarity Technologies Holdings, LP with 6 shares in table 63 row 24, DeLorean Topco, L.P. with 435 shares in table 64 row 13, and the section total at table 65 row 17. The raw-source coverage is 31/36 = 86.1%, so the failing extracted metric is a real extraction gap rather than a true absence of source shares.
